summary:
- Female, former military wife, currently living in an SRO (Single Room Occupancy) in California
- Experienced homelessness for nearly six years, actively working to help others in similar situations
- Holds a college degree in Environmental Studies, with a background in public policy and homelessness
- Strong advocate for affordable housing and flexible earning opportunities for low-income individuals
- Engaged in freelance writing and blogging, with a focus on digital independent workers and homelessness
- Identifies as a feminist, with a critical view of how women's issues are often dismissed in male-dominated spaces
- Has two special needs children, with personal experience navigating the challenges of parenting and education
- Active in local community meetings to foster connections and support for digital workers
- Critical of UBI (Universal Basic Income) as a solution to poverty, advocating instead for structural changes in housing and employment
- Engages in discussions about social justice, mental health, and the intersection of race and class in America
